idea: Eighty speckled bird eggs fly onto a bare page until, together, they write the character 书, and then the page names the film 手翻书.
leave: A book can be built from many small, different pieces.
subject: the pile of eggs, from a scatter to the character 书

device.what: eggs that land on quarter beats, two at a time at first and then in fours, fives and sixes
device.why: the character only reads once enough eggs are down, so the speed-up carries the viewer toward it

change.from: a few eggs on bare beige paper, more flying in from the edges
change.to: a few dozen eggs spread over the page, the strokes of a character starting to show
eggs landing several at a time until they fill the character 书, and the view eases in on it

change.from: the eggs gone, bare beige paper
change.to: 手翻书 set in the middle of the page
